agreement.reading: how much the two arms order the shortlist alike; 0 would mean they carry independent information

caveats: n = 14 drugs, 5 positives. Nothing here is powered; read the direction, not the p-value.

The chemical arm scores each drug against OTHER known binders, never itself, but those binders are curated annotations -- so this arm is closer to a lookup than the footprint arm is, and should be expected to do better for that reason alone.
Only CDK2 has both arms computed. No cross-target claim.
